principle: same decision question, data, windows, masks, metrics, constraints and calculation conventions
approval_rule: All structural, parameter or conclusion-affecting assumptions A1-A7 are 等待队长确认 before data conclusions.

anomalies.action: flag and paired sensitivity; no deletion or clipping

data_protocol.sampling: ordered spectrum; no random point split; FFT branch must record equispaced-wavenumber interpolation
data_protocol.windows: freeze before prototyping after captain approval

tests.procedure: check phase dimensionless, cm-um conversion, theta->0 and vanishing-reflection limits
generate preregistered two-beam spectra on observed nonuniform sigma grid over approved parameter grid; recover with B/F/P
fit/estimate on one continuous window and evaluate phase/residual behavior on a disjoint continuous window
estimate angles independently before any shared-d fit; compare M2 and residual patterns
tests.pass: threshold waiting captain confirmation; never label as true accuracy

tests.procedure: run identical pipeline on raw and reasoned-mask versions and trace every excluded row/reason
tests.pass: conclusion changes must be reported; threshold waiting captain confirmation

tests.procedure: profile objective over d and n-family parameters, inspect correlations, boundary hits and multiple starts
tests.pass: unique d only if approved threshold separates alternatives; otherwise conditional/nonidentifiable
report ranges and ranking; no predetermined stability claim

tests.procedure: verify M reduces when rear reflection vanishes, attenuation is strong, or coherence is removed
compare dispersion, low-frequency baseline, absorption, anomaly mask and multibeam branches under the same metric
tests.pass: three-state conclusion; threshold waiting captain confirmation

tests.procedure: on synthetic and observed diagnostics separately test multibeam mechanism support and thickness change
tests.pass: both captain-approved gates required to execute correction

tests.procedure: remove repeated-reflection, dispersion, absorption/baseline modules one at a time
tests.pass: claimed module must cause targeted, stable evidence; otherwise remove it

tests.procedure: record hashes, parameters, seeds if any, windows, masks, solver starts and failure codes
tests.pass: same inputs and configuration reproduce outputs

global_rejection: gain small under captain-approved practical threshold
truth_limit: No independent thickness truth is available; observed-data checks support internal consistency only.
